newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary drafts first bill on genetic engineering.
newsitem.headline: Hungary drafts first bill on genetic engineering.

text.p: The Hungarian government approved the country's first bill on genetic technology which will come into effect pending parliament's approval, the government said on Thursday.

"Genetic technology laboratories, processes and the use of all living organisms resulting from such technology would require permissioning," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference following the weekly government meeting.
He added that prior to approval, all such technologies would be subject to a risk analysis.
Kiss also said that companies or organisations using such technology will fall under the same liability rules as do hazardous industries.
Genetically modified organisms would have to be registered and food containing genetically modified components would have to be clearly labelled, Kiss said.
